interpretation.claim: This is a construction-fold retrieval reachability ground, not model task performance or a final-answer upper bound.
interpretation.reachable_upper_bound: A row is retrieval-reachable only when every required tool label is present in the frozen top-32 set. This is necessary but not sufficient for correct SELECT or FILL.
interpretation.runtime_boundary: Evaluation labels, reference transcripts, test annotations, scores, and future turns are unavailable to the runtime retriever and frozen core.
interpretation.failure_backtrack: If fresh-flight SUPPLY errors dominate, expand or reorganize construction knowledge before changing USE. If required tools are reachable but selection or exact calls fail, revise stage-specific supply and consumption instead.
